name: Retina Park-Last Service
source: Jordan is a man who enjoys solitude and avoids relationships with others. However, all of that changed drastically after he met a woman named Eleana for just two days. This Kinetic Novel was made for 1st Termiverse Anniversary.
translation: 乔丹是一个喜欢独处、避免与他人发生关系的人。然而，这一切在他认识了一个名叫埃莉安娜的女人短短两天后就发生了巨大的变化。这本动力学小说是为纪念终结者宇宙一周年而创作的。
